duplicates.cypher: MATCH (s:Substance) WITH toLower(s.name) AS normalized, collect(s.name) AS names, count(*) AS n WHERE n > 1 RETURN normalized, names, n ORDER BY normalized

clauses255.cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:HAS_CLAUSE]->(c:Clause) WHERE a.doc_id='blhs-dieu-255' RETURN c.number AS number,c.penalty AS penalty ORDER BY number
